candidates.title: Bounded independent cost-convention oracle
candidates.claim: Sections3.1,3.3,7.2,8 motivate cross-implementation comparison with fixed timing/cost specifications. Our candidate is a smaller synthetic oracle, not a replication or a new investment strategy.
candidates.question: Can an independent decimal cash/share ledger distinguish cost-base conventions without relying on equality to a no-cost rerun?
candidates.rules: Use a public Strategy.target_weights callback returning explicit desired weights encoded as the supplied scores, restricted to eligible names. Never submit fixed-share orders. Independently compute shares=target_weight*fill-time pre-cost equity/open, then traded delta, costs, cash including financing minus borrow, close marks and settlements. Warmup bars Jan2/3, signals Jan4/5/8/9 of2024; evaluation startsJan4. Jan9 last decision has no in-window fill. OHLC all equal provided closes; volume100000 each bar; all names always members.
candidates.experiment: After isolation/locked setup, compare untouched engine to audit-only standard-library Decimal ledger for all6 predeclared cases; repeat twice seed20261031. No real market inputs,6cases<=60seconds each,2GiB ceiling; no external engine dependency.
candidates.acceptance: Exact Decimal oracle arithmetic; repository finite outputs relative tolerance1e-12 (zero absolute except declared exact zeros); timestamps/orders/statuses exact. Negative control deliberately changes fee base to full holdings; it must be detected. All attempted cases retained; any mismatch stays unresolved until trace attributes cause. Every case must have positive executed notional and the intended event: fees>0, borrow>0, explicit settlement trade, or clipped fill respectively; zero-cost case must have fills and zero costs. Oracle values remain independently calculated, not copied from engine. Configs and expected counts are predeclared before execution; recording failure to reach a case rejects the harness. Zero-settlement is deliberately total insolvency: preserve insolvency status and undefined ratios, do not require every ratio finite or replace undefined with0.
candidates.benefit: Method separates specification differences from accounting failures and tests high-turnover/settlement paths; no runtime or return benefit measured.
candidates.counterargument: Existing hand-calculated tests and this audit already require independent checks; avoid duplicate testing infrastructure. Cheapest option: extend a few audit-only cases, no production layer or new engine.
candidates.novelty: new explicit queue specification; overlapping existing QUALITY-02 and mandatory audit independent checks; not claimed novel research

zero_settlement.expected_status: insolvent at2024-01-08; undefined exposure/ratio statuses permitted and must remain explicit

candidates.review_changes: Accepted independent feasibility corrections; fixed-share description superseded, explicit warmup and6case definitions added. No execution.

candidates.title: Causal capped variance overlay on a fixed momentum portfolio
candidates.claim: Moreira-Muir supports studying lagged realized-variance scaling, not this exact capped stock-selection strategy; Cederburg etal directly challenges systematic implementable out-of-sample benefit. No edge established.
candidates.hypothesis: A causal capped variance overlay improves fixed momentum risk-adjusted net performance without fitting leverage to the evaluation interval.
candidates.rules: US daily total-return-adjusted OHLC and PIT membership incl delisted equities; monthly final-session close signal P(t-21)/P(t-252)-1; average-rank top/bottom10percent, long.5short.5 gross1; next-session open fill, monthly rebalance. At monthend compute previous month's daily gross returns of the SAME unscaled fixed portfolio using data available by t close; variance mean squared demeaned daily returns ddof0; v_ref=median monthly realized variance in earliest120months of authorized exploratory development history. Freeze v_ref before later folds; multiplier=min(1,v_ref/v_t), missing/zero variance=>0cash, held to next monthly rebalance. This is deliberate no-leverage adaptation, not paper reproduction.
candidates.data: Already-inspected licensed stock OHLC, as-traded prices, PIT membership incl delistings, settlement events and borrow availability/fees before2025 only. Not accessible as raw snapshot in current verified tree. No downloads or reserved data. Model/literature exposure recorded.
candidates.comparator: Unscaled same portfolio; cash; placebo overlay shifting realized variance by12 months (causal only) as negative/control comparison, counts as an attempted variant. Risk-matched unmanaged comparator scale calibrated solely on development data.
candidates.costs: Assumptions only, not measured estimates:1bp commission +5bp halfspread per traded notional, existing sqrt impact under fixed participation1percent; borrow200bp/year for available shorts,1000bp stress; double transaction costs and one-session extra delay. All fixed, no tuning to outcomes.
candidates.experiment: First synthetic mechanics: multiply one month's daily return magnitudes by2=>variance4x=>uncapped multiplier quarter; future perturbations do not change past weights. Historical only if licensed already-inspected pre2025 snapshot available: earliest120months calibrate, next24months evaluate chronologically, roll24months without tuning; final remaining pre2025 is also exploratory. Need >=3 nonoverlapping eval folds; if insufficient history report inconclusive. Parameter family one rule only plus declared controls/stresses; seed20261031, stationary-date-block bootstrap2000,meanblock20.
candidates.acceptance: Mechanics gate exact/1e-12; exploratory support requires paired net-Sharpe difference>=.1 and95percent paired block CI lower>0 versus risk-matched unmanaged, no higher max drawdown, all cost/delay cases reported, adequate sample3folds. Failure=>not-supported, not retune. No confirmation authorized.
candidates.counterargument: Volatility management can underperform OOS; v_ref instability, reduced exposure and costs can explain apparent benefit. Capped overlay differs from original inverse-variance leveraged factor strategy. Strategy interface sees scores only, so a new audit adapter needed; production strategy changes not authorized. Cheapest adequate alternative keep unmanaged baseline.
candidates.novelty: new to this audit's published queue, no broader novelty claim; first-run topic history unavailable
candidates.feasibility: Exact calendar-month rebalancing is unsupported by fixed integer-stride engine. Do not prototype by sparse or forward-filled scores; they liquidate or rebalance daily. Keep original hypothesis blocked; a21-session-block adaptation would require a separate frozen specification and trial record. 120months calibration+72months evaluations+252session warmup requires about17years; saved2010-2024 data is insufficient and raw snapshots unavailable. Tie handling and risk-matched comparator scale still need exact tables before any experiment.
